summary: Geo-affinity flip causing streaming serialization delays and intermittent 504s
description:
Issue summary: Starting 2026-03-10 14:12 UTC customers in us-west-2 observed a sudden increase in streaming latency and intermittent 504 gateway timeouts. Symptoms appeared correlated with short-lived cross-region routing changes where live streams were re-attached to a different regional egress (geo-affinity flip).

Impact: A subset of streaming requests (user-facing chat sessions and long-generation calls) experienced serialization delays: single requests stalled for 2–8s before streaming resumed or timed out. Customer AceroHealth (dedicated) reported increased error rates and visible UI freezes for end users.

Hypothesis (short): An affinity rebalance triggered by transient network change caused active HTTP/2/GRPC streams to be proxied through a different regional egress. During the re-attachment process we observed connection serialization/backpressure at the edge-proxy connection pool resulting in elevated p50/p95/p99 for token streaming and occasional 504s when re-attachment exceeded our client timeout.

Timeline: 2026-03-10 14:12 UTC — alerts for increased 504s from us-west-2. 14:18 UTC — Support contacted SRE. 14:25 UTC — emergency route-override applied for affected customer to pin to us-west-2. 14:40 UTC — customer reports immediate improvement. Investigation continues for root cause and mitigations.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use AceroHealth's dedicated API key to start a streaming chat session from an us-west-2 client.
2) Emit a continuous stream of input (simulate typing) for ~30s to keep the connection active.
3) Trigger a controlled routing change by simulating a peering withdraw or toggling BGP session on the test edge (SRE only).
4) Observe that the client stream occasionally stalls during the re-route and may hit a 504 if re-attachment > 3s.
logs: 2026-03-10T14:12:17Z edge-proxy[proxy-7f]: INFO incoming stream client=acero-health path=/v1/chat stream_id=abc123 peer=10.3.2.14 routed_region=us-west-2
2026-03-10T14:12:20Z edge-proxy[proxy-7f]: WARN stream-attach: detected backend egress change from us-west-2 -> eu-west-1, serializing pending writes (queue_len=4)
2026-03-10T14:12:23Z serving-runtime[srv-21]: ERROR kv-cache-load timeout while waiting for slot (req=abc123) latency=2421ms
2026-03-10T14:12:27Z edge-proxy[proxy-7f]: ERROR stream-timeout req=abc123 status=504 reason=reattach_timeout duration=7.0s
2026-03-10T14:25:12Z router[robin-svc]: INFO route-override applied for customer=acero-health policy=pin-region region=us-west-2
investigation_notes: SRE observation: spikes aligned with brief BGP withdrawals between two regional egresses; robin-routing's affinity rebalance triggers were observed within the same second window as the user-visible stalls.
Edge team: connection pool serialization occurs when many live streams are handed off to a new proxy instance; current handoff delays up to 6–8s in worst cases due to synchronous drain logic.
Serving runtime: no evidence of model compute saturation; token emission resumed normally once the stream re-anchored. CPU/GPU metrics stable for affected hosts.

Hypothesis refined: the primary failure mode is routing-level re-attachment that (a) serializes pending stream writes on the new edge instance and (b) blocks the client's HTTP/2 weight budget, leading to transient timeouts if the re-attach latency exceeds client timeouts.
comments: Priya Narang (Support) 2026-03-10 14:20 UTC: Noted initial spike from customer dashboard; escalated to SRE (#support) and provisionally applied rate-limiter increase for the key to avoid throttling during retries.

SRE (Maya Chen) 2026-03-10 14:26 UTC: Applied route override to pin AceroHealth to us-west-2; immediate reduction in 504s reported by customer. Gathering debug logs from edge-proxy and robin-routing for the 14:12 window.
Customer (AceroHealth Ops) 2026-03-10 14:35 UTC: Confirmed user experience improved after pinning. They're asking for root-cause explanation and long-term fix to prevent future UI freezes.

Ethan Rodriguez (Assignee) 2026-03-11 09:10 UTC: Working with Edge/Router teams to add hysteresis and non-blocking handoff path; drafting patch to make stream re-attachment async and bounded (PR linked).
resolution:
Mitigation applied: route-override pinned the affected customer's traffic to us-west-2 which removed the immediate user impact. Temporary workaround recommended for other high-sensitivity customers: enable region pinning or set client-side streaming timeout to 10s.

Planned permanent fixes: 1) modify robin-routing affinity rebalance to add hysteresis and avoid simultaneous egress flips; 2) change edge-proxy handoff to async streaming re-attachment with bounded buffering to avoid global serialization; 3) add metric and alert for stream re-attach latency > 500ms.

Follow-ups: schedule postmortem (INT-441) and ship PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/robin-routing/pull/582. Target ETA for code fixes: 2026-03-24.
next_steps: 1) Edge team to land non-blocking re-attach patch and run canary (owner: @maya-chen).
2) Router team to add 10s hysteresis on affinity rebalance and tune BGP withdraw handling (owner: @sahil).
3) GA support runbook to include 'pin-region' advice for streaming-sensitive customers (owner: @docs).
4) Communicate interim RCA and timeline to AceroHealth by 2026-03-13 (owner: @priya).
